verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community reports. One user keeps a 60-day retention window on billions of daily rows, which implies retention can be controlled. Others describe ClickHouse as append-only with limited DELETE support, so deletion works only with significant constraints. No first-party docs in the pack describe retention or deletion mechanisms. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of retention policies and expiry, documented row- and table-level deletion semantics, any data-deletion controls on the managed cloud service, and hands-on confirmation that deletion is complete.
